BTC.note: Sold 2 Nov 2026 – no longer held; still watched for MSTR. Binance exchange hack (95% covered) and BTCPay merchant wallet drains; Bitcoin itself unaffected
BTC.detail: Binance (an exchange) lost about US$6.3bn on 29-30 Oct to North Korea-linked hackers; it was not a flaw in Bitcoin. Binance says about 95% is replaced (BTC fully backed), withdrawals reopened in phases from 1 Nov with modest net outflows, and a verifiable reserves proof is due about 3 Nov. The attacker's 18,270 stolen BTC have not moved. Separately, BTCPay Server (software merchants use to accept Bitcoin) says attackers drained hot wallets on instances running version 2.4.1 or older; the latest 2.4.7 has no credible reports. This hits merchants' online wallets, not the Bitcoin network. Strategy's custodians are not affected. Quantum: estimates keep falling but remain theoretical, hardware expected early 2030s.

TSLA.detail: No confirmed Tesla breach. A Sept 2026 hacking-forum claim is unverified.

MSTR.detail: Strategy itself was not hacked. The Binance hack only moved its share price through Bitcoin.

SEMI.detail: No breaches at SEMI's top holdings. Intel's Israel factory explosion is an operations issue, not a security one.
